title: SB2477 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to judicial proceedings.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-31; crossfiled twin https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB2695.pdf is the same printed document (it names SENATE BILL 2477); copied from TN-HB-2695-2023.draft.txt)
provenance.note: Draft dated 2024-01-31 (as filed). No votes recorded, so no amendments appear to be missing. Adds a new subdivision (6) to the list in 39-17-1306(c); the existing text of (c) is not printed in the bill.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1306(c)): (6) (A) Is an attorney in good standing and is within the building where judicial proceedings are in progress in furtherance of the attorney's representation of a party with business before the court; (B) Is authorized to carry a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1351; and (C) Keeps the handgun concealed at all times.
